name: DAPAGLIFLOZIN 10MG 28 TABLETS
description: Dapagliflozin 10 mg 28 tablets is a medication that belongs to a class called SGLT2 inhibitors, which works in the kidneys to help the body get rid of excess sugar (glucose) through urine. It is primarily used to treat type 2 diabetes, but has also proven effective for heart failure and chronic kidney disease. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
